title.narrative: Empowering Future Leaders: Fostering Entrepreneurship and Technological Skills in Young Women of Jordan

description.narrative:
Our project is designed to address the pressing issue of ‘high’ female unemployment in Jordan, which was recorded at 31.7% in 2023. It focuses on educating young women, especially in underprivileged areas, in entrepreneurship and technology. The primary objective is to provide these young women (i.e., girls) with the skills and knowledge required to navigate and succeed in today’s tech-driven, competitive economy.
Thus, the project proposes a persistent intersection between entrepreneurial competencies and digitalisation in the current digital age. More precisely, allowing potential girls and women entrepreneurs to accrue key and timely market awareness, enhancing their response to change. Accordingly, formulating a well-distinct approach for generating potential entrepreneurs who are ready to scale their forthcoming opportunities more quickly and efficiently.
It is a holistic approach to fostering positive socioeconomic change aligned with UNESCO's priorities. The project underscores a commitment to SDG 1 (No Poverty), SDG 4 (Quality Education), SDG 5 (Gender Equality), SDG 8 (Decent Work and Economic Growth), and SDG 9 (Industry, Innovation, and Infrastructure), reflecting a comprehensive effort to empower individuals and communities for a sustainable present and future.
